channel.desc: Vincent says he is desperate to rebuild his relationship with his children, but the mothers, Tasha and Sasha, say his addiction struggles are the real reason there's a divide in their family; both women share their painful stories, hoping today is the first step toward healing and bringing their family back together; Karamo guides these mothers toward the truth and a chance at unity.
